key_impacts: Harbor walls were overtopped by meteotsunami waves.
Flooding reached the shoreline and nearby city streets.
Damage reported to public docks and shoreline cottages/homes.
Water intake pumps were impacted by rapid water level changes.
Water level fluctuations up to 2 m reported outside the harbor.
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps were impacted.
Reports of water level fluctuations of 2 m along the coastline just outside the harbor; flooding into city streets.
missing_information: Exact counts/values for damaged homes, docks, and pump impacts are not provided.
